package: WP-Z4b: B3 L2 prefix SHADOW, private/action only (B3-H8 step 7 after the canon L1 PASS of attempt 4)
runner_build: g++ -O2 -std=c++17 against b10964 source headers (project folder native-sources/llama.cpp-b10964.tar.gz), linked to the b10964 release libllama.so (llama-b10964-bin-ubuntu-x64.tar.gz)
scope: task action, private view only; escalate/apologize excluded (L1 FAIL); shared view not run
pre_run_checks_done: runner without prefix reproduces the attempt-4 pooled receiver states (max rel. L2 1.3e-7, 6 rows)
plumbing smoke on 60 rows with SCRAMBLED labels, seed 0 only (numbers meaningless, not looked at as evidence)
pipeline: attempt-4 aux bridge retrained per seed with the identical recipe/splits (seeds 0..4, fit/select/test 360/120/120) -> z[4,8] BF16 -> alignment -> calibration -> 4 prefix slots via batch.embd (IMROPE positions) -> receiver final states, mean over private-view tokens only -> L1 NO_MESSAGE readout (PCA 48, standardized, softmax head, l2 on select)

variants.PCA_ALIGN: PRIMARY (decides verdict): per-slot standardized message dims -> top-8 principal directions of fit-split native input-token embeddings (shared-view texts), scaled by native spread
variants.EXACT_ALIGN: EXPLORATORY: ridge (l2 by select MSE) from flat message to receiver token-embedding means of the 4 cue sentences; a PASS here only motivates a confirmatory rerun on fresh data

calibration: recentre on native mean, scale mean fit-split deviation norm to native token deviation norm; B3-H4 packet reported

controls.PREFIX_RANDOM: native-spread Gaussian, deviation norm matched per item/slot

baselines: EXACT (oracle cue span tokens), SYMBOLIC ('Suggested action: <word>.' from sender head), SYMBOLIC_ATTR ('Urgency <lvl>, frustration <lvl>.' from sender tertile heads) as token embeddings in the prefix position, same readout; bytes as attempt 4
gate: b3bridge.l2_gate: paired mean-2se>0 vs PREFIX_OFF, PREFIX_SHUFFLED, PREFIX_RANDOM; utility (BYTES_W .25, BYTES_NORM 4000) beats EXACT, SYMBOLIC, SYMBOLIC_ATTR; topic role drop <=0.01; norm ratio in [0.8,1.25]; bit-identical rerun of 8 items
reported_not_gated: L2 vs L1 adapter read (paired), full-1024 readout (exploratory), drift cosine, off-trained topic head on prefixed states, L1 reproduction vs attempt 4
verdict_rule: single run; FAIL stays FAIL; no setting changes count as this attempt
expectation: uncertain; frozen receiver may ignore an off-manifold 4-slot prefix in its own-token states (likely FAIL vs EXACT on utility is possible too)
consequence_if_pass: L3 tiny-residual SHADOW test allowed for private/action; LATENT authority stays 0; runtime unchanged
consequence_if_fail: B3_LATENT stays at L1_shadow for private/action; L3 locked; record negative result
hardware: Linux x86_64 cloud CPU, 4 threads; not Redmi
